pareto_reference.rationale: BCE losses are unbounded above; existing historical/control validation records had maximum BCE 0.6414133221375151 and no BCE above 2.0, so the BCE coordinates use a frozen conservative pre-MOO bound of 2.0 while the ranking coordinate remains the analytic 1-NDCG@10 upper bound 1.0.

ferero.ray_mapping: v=(1/r)/||1/r||_2; B_h[i]=v[i+1]*e_0-v[0]*e_(i+1); H=B_h*normalized_losses; A=I; no performance bounds

phn_hvi.preference_semantics: Hypernetwork input r is objective importance, as in existing PHN; cosine loss-ray is normalized 1/r to preserve rank_heavy meaning.

upstream.license: No repository license found at pinned commit; source not vendored
deviations: Five existing normalized objectives replace federated clients; minibatch gradients replace local client parameter deltas; frozen Adam outer optimizer; three independent TiM4Rec models.
No warmup in centralized minibatch training; fixed set_obj_stepsize=1, no decay, no gradient rescaling beyond train diagnostic losses.

Official IPOT, adjusted marginals, conditional MGDA, masking, linearized cost and EMA are retained. The pinned Frank-Wolfe solver returns after its first iteration; this behavior is deliberately preserved, not silently repaired.

In the MGDA branch official coefficients combine raw gradients after solving on transport-weighted gradients; this convention is preserved. CPU-safe one-active-objective case avoids upstream unconditional .cuda().

validation_id_integrity.source: existing VALID inter, read-only in-memory extraction

data_access.mechanism: Python audit hook plus guarded RecBole loader factory; installed before dataset construction
